x.name: X
x.culture: Fast, blunt and public. Replies are short; quote posts are used to argue or to add a take.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.culture: Professional and polite on the surface. People comment with their own experience and job title in mind; open disagreement is rarer but pointed.

threads.name: Threads
threads.culture: Casual and friendly. Lots of short agreement; pushback tends to be gentle.

bluesky.name: Bluesky
bluesky.culture: Text-first and opinionated. People call out hype and AI claims quickly.

reddit.name: Reddit
reddit.culture: Skeptical of self-promotion. Comments ask for details and sources; the top comment often disagrees.

generic.name: a social feed
generic.culture: A general audience: most people scroll, some react, a few reply.
